description_zh: 调用ModifyScalingRule接口修改弹性扩、缩容规则
name: ModifyScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The application ID
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The deployment group ID
parameters.help_zh: 部署分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The trigger condition. Valid values:

OR: Any condition.
AND: All conditions
parameters.help_zh:
触发条件。

OR：任一条件
AND：所有条件
parameters.name: in_condition

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the scale-in rule. Valid values:

true: Included.
false: Not included
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含缩容规则。

true：包含
false：不包含
parameters.name: in_enable

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: CPU utilization
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率
parameters.name: in_cpu

parameters.help_en: The duration, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟
parameters.name: in_duration

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances to retain when the group scales in
parameters.help_zh: 分组缩容时需要保留的最小实例数
parameters.name: in_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: system load
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：系统负载
parameters.name: in_load

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: service latency. Unit: milliseconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0
parameters.name: in_rt

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to scale in at a time
parameters.help_zh: 每次缩容的实例数
parameters.name: in_step

parameters.help_en:
The trigger condition. Valid values:

OR: Any condition.
AND: All conditions
parameters.help_zh:
触发条件。

OR：任一条件
AND：所有条件
parameters.name: out_condition

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: CPU utilization
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率
parameters.name: out_cpu

parameters.help_en: The duration, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟
parameters.name: out_duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the scale-out rule
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含扩容规则
parameters.name: out_enable

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances when the group scales out
parameters.help_zh: 分组扩容时的最大实例数
parameters.name: out_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: system load
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：系统负载
parameters.name: out_load

parameters.help_en: The trigger metric: service latency. Unit: milliseconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0
parameters.name: out_rt

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to scale out at a time
parameters.help_zh: 每次扩容的实例数
parameters.name: out_step

parameters.help_en:
The source of instances for scale-out. Valid values:
NEW: Elastic resources.
AVAILABLE: Existing resources. To prioritize existing resources, use AVAILABLE_FIRST.

If you set this parameter to NEW or AVAILABLE_FIRST, you must specify auto scaling parameters. Auto scaling includes two modes: launch template and existing instance rule
parameters.help_zh:
扩容实例来源。
NEW：弹性资源。
AVAILABLE：已有资源。已有资源优先为AVAILABLE_FIRST。

NEW或AVAILABLE_FIRST需指定弹性扩容参数，弹性扩容包括两种模式：启动模版和基于现有实例规则
parameters.name: resource_from

parameters.help_en:
The multi-zone scaling policy for auto scaling. Valid values:
PRIORITY: Priority policy.
BALANCE: Balanced distribution policy
parameters.help_zh:
弹性扩容的多可用区扩缩容策略。包含两种策略：
PRIORITY：优先级策略。
BALANCE：均衡分布策略
parameters.name: multi_az_policy

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID associated with the launch template or existing instance rule for auto scaling
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的“启动模版”或“基于现有实例规则”所关联的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs in the VPC. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: VPC相关的vswitch ID列表，多个以半角逗号（,）分割
parameters.name: vswitchids

parameters.help_en:
The reclamation mode for scale-in. Valid values:
release: Release mode.
recycle: Stop and reclaim mode
parameters.help_zh:
弹性缩容的回收模式。
release：释放模式
recycle：停机回收模式
parameters.name: scaling_policy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for the existing instance rule of auto scaling. This parameter is valid only when OutEnable is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效
parameters.name: template_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name for the existing instance rule of auto scaling. This parameter is valid only when TemplateInstanceId is specified
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例名称。TemplateInstanceId存在才有效
parameters.name: template_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The logon password of the instance. This parameter is valid only when the existing instance rule is used for auto scaling
parameters.help_zh: 实例登录密码。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The name of the logon key pair for the instance. This parameter is valid only when the existing instance rule is used for auto scaling
parameters.help_zh: 实例登录密钥名称。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: Must be set to true if auto scaling is used
parameters.help_zh: 若使用弹性扩容，则必须设置为true
parameters.name: accept_eula

parameters.help_en: The launch template ID for auto scaling. This parameter is valid only when OutEnable is set to true, and it has a higher priority than TemplateInstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效，优先级高于TemplateInstanceId
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The launch template version for auto scaling. This parameter is valid only when OutEnable is set to true. Set this parameter to `-1` to use the default template version, or set it to a specific version number
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”版本。OutEnable为true（真）才有效。若使用默认模版，则设置为`-1`，否则设置为相应的版本号
parameters.name: template_version
